Confira a vaga para Senior fpga developer em porto alegre. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.Responsibilities :The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.Qualifications :BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.Required Skills :Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Pesquisador doutor - markal - pesquisa e desenvolvimento em soluções de pulverização - doutores inovando no setor empresarial - iel pr
description:

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.    O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.    Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.    Sobre a Oportunidade:    Você deseja atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções voltadas à pulverização agrícola e contribuir para a evolução de produtos e componentes com alto impacto no campo? O projeto envolve o desenvolvimento e detalhamento de produtos e componentes, além da estruturação de documentação técnica e materiais que assegurem padronização e suporte à aplicação em campo.    Buscamos um profissional com visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica e forte domínio técnico para transformar requisitos em soluções viáveis, conduzir detalhamentos de projeto com precisão e garantir a qualidade da entrega por meio da elaboração de manuais técnicos e padronizações. Também será essencial apoiar a capacitação da equipe técnica, fortalecendo a transferência de conhecimento e a consolidação de boas práticas de engenharia. Se você tem afinidade com desenvolvimento de produto, documentação técnica e inovação aplicada ao agronegócio, esta oportunidade é para você.    Formação Acadêmica:    Engenharia mecânica ou mecatrônica    Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.    Projeto: Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em soluções de pulverização.    Principais Atividades:   Desenvolvimento de soluções para pulverização agrícola Modelagem e prototipagem 3 D em Solid Works Acompanhamento de projetos do início ao fim, incluindo implantação fabril Desenvolvimento de melhorias para produtos já existentes Elaboração de materiais técnicos para produção (desenhos técnicos) Desenvolvimento de documentos técnicos (manuais de instrução e catálogo de peças)  Conhecimento necessário:   Domínio pleno do Solid Works Capacidade de elaborar montagens de alta complexidade Realizar e avaliar cálculos estruturais e de funcionamento mecânico dos sistemas projetados Habilidade em desenho técnico 2 D e 3 D Construção detalhada da estrutura de itens (BOM/estrutura do produto) Elaboração de desenhos com especificações de corte, dobra, solda e usinagem Conhecimento de normas ABNT e NR's aplicáveis à área de projeto e engenharia Atenção a requisitos de segurança de máquina e critérios de projeto conforme normativas reconhecidas Realização de simulações mecânicas no Solid Works (Simulation) para validação e acurácia do projeto  Conhecimento Desejável   Proatividade para identificar e apresentar oportunidades de melhoria e soluções criativas Disciplina e organização no trabalho Compromisso com prazos e entregas Respeito à hierarquia e às diretrizes internas  Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial    Formato de trabalho: Presencial    Local: Santa Tereza do Oeste/PR    Soft Skills: Autogestão; Pensamento crítico; Criatividade; Organização; Autonomia.

title: Secretário médico
description:
Confira a vaga para Secretário médico em são josé dos campos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da empresa Bruni Instituto é uma clínica médica que busca oferecer um serviço diferenciado e acolhedor para pacientes que buscam procedimentos estéticos de face. A atuação é focada em atendimento presencial com valorização da comunicação clara e do respeito às necessidades de cada pessoa. A rotina privilegia processos bem estruturados para agendamento de consultas organização de prontuários e suporte à equipe médica. O ambiente de trabalho incentiva responsabilidade ética e foco em qualidade impecável no atendimento.    Descrição do cargo A pessoa que ocupará o cargo de secretário médico atuará em tempo integral em regime presencial em São José dos Campos SP. No dia a dia será responsável por realizar agendamentos de consultas e procedimentos, recepcionar pacientes organizar prontuários e documentos e fazer o controle de retornos e encaixes. Também apoiará na manutenção da agenda do profissional de saúde atender ligações e mensagens esclarecer dúvidas sobre horários e orientações básicas e encaminhar demandas ao médico quando necessário. Faz parte da rotina registrar informações no sistema do consultório manter dados atualizados e assegurar sigilo das informações dos pacientes.    Paralelamente, será necessário dar suporte à equipe de marketing para suporte de atendimento por redes sociais.    Qualificações É necessário possuir habilidades em agendamento de consultas com experiência em appointment scheduling e organização de agenda em ambiente de consultório médico. A pessoa candidata deve demonstrar domínio de tarefas administrativas e de escritório incluindo clerical skills digitação e organização de arquivos físicos e digitais. É importante ter conhecimento de terminologia médica e rotina de medical office compreendendo procedimentos básicos fluxo de atendimento e normas de confidencialidade. Desejável boa fluência em digitação e uso de computador com capacidade de operar sistemas de gestão de consultório e ferramentas de escrita e planilhas. Serão diferenciais experiência prévia em recepção ou secretariado na área da saúde, ensino médio completo ou técnico em administração ou secretariado além de habilidade em atendimento ao público e postura ética cuidadosa. Indispensável o uso correto da língua portuguesa. Boa postura e boa apresentação também são essenciais.

Requisitos / Qualificações Formação superior em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas; Experiência sólida em RH generalista, com vivência em varejo ou operações com muitos colaboradores e múltiplas unidades; Histórico de atuação em estruturação ou reestruturação de processos de RH — não apenas execução; Experiência com treinamento e desenvolvimento, cultura organizacional e onboarding; Inglês não é requisito; o requisito é entender de gente. Diferenciais valorizados Vivência com implantação de plano de cargos e salários; Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de desempenho ou plataformas de RH; Perfil com viés de cultura e engajamento, não apenas processos. O que esperamos de vocêMentalidade construtora: você vai encontrar muito por fazer — e enxergar isso como oportunidade, não como problema; Presença e influência natural para ser comprado(a) por líderes e colaboradores de diferentes perfis; Capacidade de dar ideias, propor caminhos e defender seu ponto de vista com embasamento; Adaptabilidade ao ritmo do varejo: aqui os dias são cheios e o negócio não para; Vontade genuína de fazer parte de algo que está sendo construído.

title: Engenheiro civil
description:

Como Líder de Obras na Rôgga, o seu desafio principal será liderar todas as etapas da construção, monitorando a execução de todas as etapas do planejamento de obras. Acompanhando os projetos e equipes de obras e empreiteiras, atendendo todas as premissas e parâmetros estipulados, com entrega de resultados para a empresa e satisfação com os produtos e serviços para os clientes, gerindo equipe de obra através da Cultura Rôgga.    Responsabilidades e atribuições   Gerenciamento, acompanhamento e fiscalização de obra. Elaboração e acompanhamento de cronograma de obra (planejamento). Zelar pelo orçamento base da obra bem como fazer a gestão do controle de custos em obra, entre outras atividades pertinentes a função. Manter o quadro de pessoal necessário ao desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e obtenção de resultados. Gerenciar e orientar equipe para a execução de atividades de acordo com os projetos, orientando a execução, acompanhando e cobrando os resultados nas formas e prazos estabelecidos da obra. Monitorar a entrada de insumos e materiais para o cumprimento do cronograma da obra. Responder pelos padrões de qualidade e segurança das obras. Elaborar relatórios, registrando os trabalhos executados, as vistorias realizadas e as alterações ocorridas em relação aos projetos aprovados. Manter equipe engajada e alinhada aos valores Rôgga, fazendo a gestão das pessoas. Acompanhar os custos da obra de acordo com o orçamento pré estabelecido (evitar desperdícios). Responder pelo custo realizado, prazo, qualidade e segurança das obras. Participar ativamente dos programas de qualidade, segurança e demais programas da empresa. Realizar medição de mão de obra terceirizada. Apontamento de produção. Requisições de materiais para empreiteiras.  Requisitos e qualificações   Necessário graduação em Engenharia Civil ou Arquitetura. Vivência em empreendimentos verticais multifamiliares, em obras de estrutura convencional e alvenaria estrutural.

Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin: Where purpose comes to life.    You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.      Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it’s facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better.      Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?        We are currently looking for a Head of Environment, Health, and Safety to join us at our team in Joinville . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.      The Role  This person will be responsible for leading and ensuring the national management of Industrial Safety, Environment and Occupational Health programs and activities.      Your Responsibilities: Guarantee compliance with applicable legal requirements on environmental, industrial safety and occupational health issues. Achieve zero accidents resulting from work activities. Reduce the incidence of occupational diseases. Establish action plans in Industrial Safety, Environment and Occupational Health (HSE).    Your Profile:   You have a degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Safety and Hygiene, Environment, health sciences, or similar fields. Desirable: Postgraduate in Safety and Hygiene, Environment, health sciences.   You have +5 years of experience as a leader (supervisor, coordinator) in Safety and Hygiene, Environment & health in manufacturing industry.   English proficiency, we will have our interview in English. The position requires preparing reports, attending audits and meetings in English.   You are a teamplayer, motivator and excellent communicator with an entreprenaurial drive.      What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers    Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B& I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.      Organization    Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B& I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B& I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.      Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

description:

SC — Regional Sales Representative    Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development    Position Details    Job Title: SC — Regional Sales Representative    Department: Sales & Business Development — LATAM    Reports To: Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM    Location: Santa Catarina, Brazil    Work Arrangement: Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)    Role Overview    The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.g., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines.    Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.    Key Responsibilities   Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations. Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory. Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards. Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments. Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel. Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities. Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities. Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company. Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information. Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.  Qualifications & Requirements    Required   Experience: Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the Io T segment. Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Customer-Centric: Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals. Location: Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.  Preferred   Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, Lo Ra, satellite communication, and antennas. Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil. Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial Io T, or connected mobility verticals. Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot) and standard productivity software. Spanish language skills a plus.  About Quectel    Quectel is a global Io T solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5 G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and Io T connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.    With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (Io T platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.    Life at Quectel LATAM    At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Direct access to global R& D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams. A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.  Industries & Applications    Quectel's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions. Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring. Industrial Io T & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring. Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T — Connected appliances, energy management, security.  Why Quectel LATAM?   Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology — Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.  Compensation & Benefits   Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).  Explore Quectel — Links & Resources    We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Sobre a função O(A) Entrevistador(a) é responsável pela coleta de informações em domicílios participantes dos painéis da empresa, contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade dos dados utilizados por nossos clientes na tomada de decisões estratégicas. Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, organizados e com excelente relacionamento interpessoal para atuar em atividades de campo, seguindo padrões de qualidade e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa. Entregar/enviar comunicados e materiais informativos aos participantes do painel. Acompanhar e auxiliar solicitações de resgate de recompensas de acordo com a pontuação acumulada pelos participantes. Retornar aos domicílios sempre que necessário para corrigir informações, complementar dados ou esclarecer dúvidas. Atualizar continuamente o cadastro dos moradores, registrando alterações como entrada ou saída de residentes, nascimento de crianças e outras mudanças relevantes. Manter atualizadas as informações sobre animais de estimação e bens de consumo do domicílio. Realizar a atualização anual do censo domiciliar, garantindo a consistência e integridade das informações cadastradas. Transmitir os dados coletados dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Executar pesquisas especiais e projetos específicos quando designado pela empresa. Perfil desejado Ensino médio completo. Boa comunicação verbal e facilidade para se relacionar com diferentes perfis de pessoas. Cordialidade, empatia e postura profissional durante as visitas domiciliares. Capacidade de despertar confiança e engajamento dos participantes da pesquisa. Organização e atenção aos detalhes na coleta e registro das informações. Comprometimento com prazos, qualidade dos dados e cumprimento de procedimentos. Voz clara, audível e boa dicção. Responsabilidade na utilização da identificação da empresa, mantendo o crachá visível durante toda a execução das entrevistas. Diferenciais Experiência com atendimento ao público, pesquisas de campo ou visitas domiciliares. Familiaridade com o uso de dispositivos móveis e aplicativos de coleta de dados. Facilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma, seguindo rotas e cronogramas definidos. Numerator is a data company transforming how consumers and markets are understood. Powered by advanced technology and proprietary, zero-party purchase and survey data from more than one million households, Numerator provides visibility into consumer behavior and attitudes across consumer goods, retail, restaurants, tech and media, management consulting, institutional investors, and the public sector. Headquartered in Chicago, Numerator drives decisions at the world's largest and fastest-growing companies in more than 50 countries.

Summary Description We are looking for a Senior Aeronautical Hydromechanical Systems Designer to work on the development, integration, and detailing of hydromechanical systems in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professional will be responsible for technical leading design activities, proposing robust solutions for highly complex systems, and acting as a technical reference for the team, contributing to all phases of the product development cycle, from conception to certification. Key Responsibilities: • Develop aeronautical hydromechanical installation projects in a 3 D CAD environment; • Prepare installation layouts, integration drawings, and technical documentation; • Develop solutions for the installation of hydraulic, environmental (AMS/ECS), fuel, propulsion, and other embedded mechanical systems; • Specify aeronautical components, materials, piping, hoses, connections, and hardware; • Prepare bills of materials (BOM) and engineering documentation; • Develop integration solutions between hydromechanical systems, structures, electrical systems, and avionics; • Perform integration, segregation, and install ability analyses of systems; • Conduct technical analyses and support the definition of the physical architecture of hydromechanical systems; • Support manufacturing, installation, integration, and troubleshooting activities in the field; • Support development, qualification, and certification testing campaigns; • Analyze technical requirements and ensure their correct implementation in the project; • Act as a technical interface with clients, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams; • Prepare and review technical documentation according to internal processes and certification requirements; • Provide technical guidance to junior and senior professionals, disseminating best practices in engineering and design; • Contribute to the standardization, continuous improvement, and evolution of engineering processes. Requirements Education • Technical course in Mechanics, Mechatronics, Electromechanics or related areas. Desirable: • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechatronics or related areas. Experience • Over 10 years of experience in the design of aeronautical hydromechanical systems. • Proven experience in aircraft development, modification or certification programs. Technical knowledge Hydromechanical Systems Project • Design and detailing of aeronautical hydromechanical installations; • Hydraulic Systems; • Environmental Systems (AMS/ECS); • Fuel Systems; • Propulsion Systems; • Pneumatic Systems; • Installation of engines, APU and their associated systems; • Sizing and installation of rigid and flexible piping; • Definition of supports, fixings and mechanical interfaces; • Specification of aeronautical components, materials, piping, connections and hardware; • Preparation of bills of materials (BOM); • Reading and interpreting technical drawings and engineering documentation. Aeronautical Knowledge • Aeronautical Product Development Process; • Integration and segregation of systems; • Aeronautical manufacturing and assembly process; • Best practices for installing aeronautical systems; • Development, qualification, and certification testing; • Application of Service Bulletins and major modifications (STC); • Certification process for civil and military aircraft. Tools Desirable experience with tools such as: • CATIA V5 / 3 DEXPERIENCE; • Microsoft Office. Desired skills • Analytical thinking and ability to solve complex problems; • Organization and planning; • Clear and objective technical communication; • Ability to act as a technical reference in multidisciplinary teams; • Ease of interpersonal relationships; • Collaborative and results-oriented profile; • Proactivity and sense of responsibility; • Autonomy in technical decision-making; • Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines; • Ability to guide and develop less experienced professionals. Differentials Experience in the following will be considered a plus: • Large-scale aeronautical modification projects (STC); • Civil or military certification programs; • Hydraulic flight control systems; • Fuel systems; • Environmental systems (ECS/AMS); • Pneumatic systems; • Installation of engines, APUs, and nacelles; • Integration of special and mission systems; • DOORS, Polarion, or requirements management tools; • FAR/CS 23 or 25 standards; • ARP4754 A, ARP4761, and DO-160; • ANAC, FAA, or EASA certification processes; • Installability, maintainability, functional safety, and multidisciplinary interface analyses. Languages • Advanced English for reading, interpreting, and preparing technical documentation. • Fluent English will be considered a plus. Availability • National and international travel, when necessary. • Ability to work different shifts as needed by projects. What do we expect We are looking for professionals passionate about aeronautical engineering, with solid technical experience and the ability to lead highly complex solutions. We expect individuals committed to excellence in engineering, who work collaboratively, positively influence team development, and contribute to the delivery of safe, innovative, and certifiable projects, strengthening the technical capacity and competitiveness of Systems Engineering.

description:

Que desafio temos para você? Estamos em busca de Líder Almoxarifado para atuar no nosso time de Suprimentos. Quais as responsabilidades? Supervisionar emissão, entrada e saída de notas fiscais; Supervisionar entrada e saída de combustível no posto de abastecimento e atender as exigências legais dos órgãos fiscalizadores; Supervisionar o processo de estocagem dos materiais, de forma a preservar a sua integridade física e condições de uso, de acordo com as características de cada material, bem como facilitar a sua localização e manuseio; Supervisionar controles dos estoques, através de registros apropriados (SAP), visando facilitar a reposição e elaboração dos inventários; Elaboração de inventário; Gerar relatórios de acompanhamento. Quais os requisitos? Cursando Técnico ou Graduação Engenharia/Administração; Experiência (Estoque e/ou Controle); Conhecimento pacote office; CNH AB; Localidades: Residir em São José do Rio Preto, Tanabi ou Monte Aprazível. O que buscamos num profissional? Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência. A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa. Sobre a Tereos Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões. Tereos no Brasil A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

Sobre a vaga    A COFCO International é uma empresa global de agronegócios que compra, armazena, vende, processa e distribui commodities agrícolas essenciais: grãos, oleaginosas, açúcar, algodão e café. Responsabilidades Executar o monitoramento de equipamentos e frotas agrícolas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria relacionadas a tempos improdutivos, inconsistências de apontamentos e falhas operacionais; Apoiar as operações logísticas por meio da utilização de ferramentas tecnológicas de rastreamento, monitoramento online e comunicação operacional, contribuindo para a eficiência e continuidade das operações; Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo do desempenho das frentes de operações agrícolas, elaborando comunicação estratégica junto aos gestores das áreas envolvidas (Agrícola, Manutenção Automotiva, Indústria, Planejamento, entre outras), com foco em performance e melhorias operacionais; Efetuar abertura e encerramento de Ordens de Serviço de equipamentos em manutenção, acompanhando indicadores de indisponibilidade da frota, monitoramento online dos equipamentos e follow-up de previsão de retorno à operação, garantindo alinhamento entre operação, manutenção e equipe GOA; Monitorar focos de incêndio por meio do sistema GMG, realizando análise das ocorrências identificadas, acionamento imediato da brigada responsável e registro das informações no sistema, assegurando agilidade na tratativa e suporte às ações de combate; Realizar monitoramento preventivo de frotas, analisando divergências de sonolência, fadiga e condutas irregulares de risco apontadas pelos sistemas e atuando de forma proativa na mitigação de cenários de risco; Acompanhar operações e equipamentos de Plantio e Tratos Culturais, com foco em otimização de processos, produtividade e eficiência operacional das frentes agrícolas; Executar o cadastro e atualização de equipamentos nos sistemas de monitoramento e gestão operacional. title: Aeronautical hydromechanical systems designer - junior
description:

Summary Description    We are looking for a Junior Aeronautical Hydromechanical Systems Designer to work on the development and detailing of hydromechanical systems in civil and military aeronautical programs. The professionals will participate in system design and integration activities, working under the guidance of more experienced professionals and contributing to the development of technical solutions aligned with program requirements and aeronautical certification standards.      Key Responsibilities:   • Support the development of aeronautical hydromechanical installation projects in a 3 D CAD environment;   • Prepare and review technical drawings and engineering documentation;   • Assist in the detailing of hydraulic, environmental (AMS/ECS), fuel, propulsion, and other onboard mechanical systems installations;   • Assist in the specification of aeronautical components, materials, and hardware;   • Prepare bills of materials (BOM) and technical project documentation;   • Support integration activities between hydromechanical systems, structures, electrical systems, and avionics;   • Participate in system integration and segregation analyses;   • Support manufacturing, assembly, and installation activities of systems;   • Assist in development testing, qualification, and certification activities;   • Participate in the analysis and implementation of technical requirements under the guidance of the team;   • Interact with multidisciplinary teams for the development of engineering solutions;   • Contribute to the preparation of technical documentation in accordance with internal processes and certification requirements.      Requirements    Education   • Technical course in Mechanics, Mechatronics, Electromechanics or related areas.    Desirable:   • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechatronics or related areas (in progress or completed).      Experience   • Between 2 and 6 years of experience in mechanical design or aeronautical systems.   • Previous experience in an aeronautical environment will be considered a plus.      Technical knowledge    Hydromechanical Systems Project   • Basic design and detailing of aeronautical hydromechanical installations;   • Basic concepts of hydraulic systems;   • Basic concepts of environmental systems (AMS/ECS);   • Basic concepts of fuel systems;   • Basic concepts of propulsion systems;   • Reading and interpreting technical drawings;   • Basic concepts of aeronautical systems integration;   • Basic concepts of Bills of Materials (BOM).      Aeronautical Knowledge   • Basic concepts of the Aeronautical Product Development Process;   • Basic concepts of system integration and segregation;   • Basic concepts of aeronautical manufacturing and assembly;   • Good practices for installing aeronautical systems;   • Basic concepts of development, qualification, and certification testing;   • Basic knowledge of the aircraft certification process will be considered a plus.      Tools    Experience with tools such as:   • CATIA V5 / 3 DEXPERIENCE;   • Microsoft Office.     5 – Desired skills   • Interest in learning and developing technically;   • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills;   • Organization and planning;   • Good verbal and written communication;   • Multidisciplinary teamwork;   • Ease of interpersonal relationships;   • Proactivity and sense of responsibility;   • Commitment to quality, safety, and deadlines;   • Adaptability to work in a dynamic environment.      Differentials    Knowledge or experience in the following will be considered a plus:   • Aeronautical projects;   • Hydraulic, environmental (ECS/AMS), fuel, or propulsion systems;   • CATIA V5 or 3 DEXPERIENCE;   • Aeronautical manufacturing processes;   • FAR/CS 23 or 25;   • DO-160;   • Technical English focused on aeronautical documentation.      Languages   • Intermediate English for reading and interpreting technical documentation. • Advanced English will be considered a plus.      Availability   • Domestic and international travel, when necessary.   • Working different shifts, as needed by the company.     5 – What do we expect    We are looking for professionals interested in building a career in the aeronautical industry, who are eager to learn, have a collaborative spirit, and are committed to technical excellence. We expect proactive, organized, and motivated individuals to develop high-quality engineering solutions, contributing to the success of programs and their professional growth within the Systems Engineering team.
